# Security

CoreTend works on local files. Please report a problem with path validation, permissions, the
optional system helper or moves to the Trash privately, through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ahmetbsbnr/coretend/security/advisories/new).
Do not attach real personal data.

Fixes ship in the next release; the issue is disclosed once people have had a reasonable chance
to update.
